sloka: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं तथापि व्यथितेन्द्रियः।पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मन्यते स्मर्क्षपुङ्गवः ।। ६.७४.२५ ।।
transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyaṁ tathāpi vyathitendriyaḥ।punarjātamivātmānaṁ manyate smarkṣapuṅgavaḥ ।। 6.74.25 ।।

translations.english: Then again, Jambavan whose senses were affected, on hearing the statement of Hanuman, the foremost of Vanaras, felt as though he was born again.
